recurring_harms: misinformation and opportunity loss;discrimination;privacy loss;dignity loss;financial loss
human_in_loop_decisions: Every decision the four products touch that changes a person's access to care, access to a job, control over their own voice and likeness, or what the public is told stays with a named human who sees the underlying evidence, can override without asking permission, and leaves a reason record. In all four submissions the reviewer only counts as a control where the workflow also gives them time and authority, which is why each member paired the reviewer with a stop threshold rather than relying on review alone.
strongest_guardrails: No autonomous decision at the high-stakes moment; one hard threshold that pauses the feature instead of only logging a warning; evidence reported per affected group rather than as an average; provenance and consent records wherever a real person's data, voice or likeness enters the system; and a fallback path that still works with the model switched off.
cross_industry_pattern: Counting the four harm maps together gives 16 harm rows across healthcare triage, hiring, news verification and creator voice. Eight of those 16 rows land on an affected-non-customer against 4 on the paying user, so the person who carries the harm is usually not the person who bought or used the product. The failure layers spread the same way: the model is the most common single starting layer at 4 of 16 rows, but 12 of 16 harms start outside it, in data, governance process, user experience, integration tooling or the safety system. A release gate that only tests model accuracy would therefore miss three quarters of what the group found. Healthcare is the highest stakes of the four because it is the only one where the harm is physical injury and the decision was rated hard-to-reverse, while the hiring, news and creator identity harms were all rated partially-reversible. All four members landed on conditional-go, and the conditions had the same shape every time: a named human owner, one threshold that stops the feature, and evidence broken out by affected group.
